hotels.title: Victoria High Country Alpine Apartments near Mount Buller with Daily Breakfast & Daily Drinks
hotels.description: Leave the hustle of the city behind and escape to Victoria’s High Country for a relaxing, ski-friendly apartment stay. This secluded retreat is ensconced between the charming town of Mansfield and Mount Buller’s alpine slopes. Surrounded by acres of lush greenery, gourmet eateries, wineries and sleepy rivers, this peaceful resort is perfect for group escapes or a romantic weekend trip. The High Country and Great Dividing Range region, renowned for its walking and cycling trails, cosy pubs, quaint cafes and forested landscape, is on your doorstep and just waiting to be explored. After a day outdoors, relax and unwind in your blissfully private, self-contained apartment, offering easy access to a seasonal outdoor pool, spa and sauna, a private lake for boating and fishing, and an 18-hole mini-golf course.
